title: Dutch Apple Pie
hookLine: Netherlands-inspired dutch apple pie with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Dutch Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the flour, 150 gr of the sugar, pinch of salt and 1 egg yolk in the bowl of a food processor. Cut the butter into small cubes and add to the bowl. Turn this into a firm dough. Don't over process, you do not want the dough to turn warm. Check if it sticks by pinching it between your fingers. Turn out onto a piece of plastic wrap. Make a round ball of it by using your hands and roll it into the plastic. Place into the fridge for half an hour to cool. Take a round baking tin of 22 cm diameter and cover this with baking paper. Brush the sides with butter. Incorporate {m53386_1}, {m53386_2}, {m53386_3}, and {m53386_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 170˚C (340˚F) Cut the apple into cubes and mix this with the raisins, the left over sugar and the cinnamon. Place the cooled dough on a flat surface sprinkled with flour and roll out into a thin sheet. Place this into the baking tin and cover the bottom and the sides well. I usually just press it into the tin without rolling it out. I find that the easiest way but it is less smooth. Just do whatever works for you. Incorporate {m53386_5}, {m53386_6}, {m53386_7}, {m53386_8}, and {m53386_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Make sure you keep 1/4 of the dough separate to form the strips on the top. Once the bottom and sides are covered with the dough, take the rusks and crumble them over the bottom. You can use breadcrumbs for this as well. Shake it a bit so it is divided equally across the bottom. Add the apple mixture and divide well over the tin. Rol out the rest of the dough and cut into strips. Place that over the top of the pie in a diamond shaped pattern. Brush the strokes and sides with the other egg yolk and place in the preaheated oven.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake the apple pie for about 1 hour or until golden and cooked through. Leave to cool in the tin and make sure the sides are loose before opening the tin.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
